data_requests.item: Existing named-pump service, protective minimum-flow and line-association basis
where: site records: Existing pump/vendor minimum-flow and service/curve records, actual return-line purpose and routing, protective control function and operating modes; retain exact pump/source/revision/availability and uncertainty.

a walkdown: Only if existing records leave an applicable question unresolved, agree safe additional observations with the responsible engineer; no compulsory new field test, operating change or retrofit.
data_requests.how: A nearby MIN FLOW, RO or automatic-recirculation label is a candidate, not proof of measured continuous discharge-return flow. Establish the actual pump/service and association first, and retain the vendor minimum-flow protection. Known positive-displacement/vacuum/metering or helper equipment is outside this bounded centrifugal-pump investigation; unknown eligible service stays conditional. Suitable protective operation and existing reviewed records may be acknowledged without a new measurement.

questions.decision_rule: Review the whole pump/system duty and actual operating records with the responsible engineer. Continuous recirculation, an open orifice or missing model data alone is not a diagnosis or instruction to remove/restrict protection. Acknowledge appropriate automatic low-flow operation or suitable existing basis; unresolved minimum-flow, association, quantities or coverage remains a records question. No automatic action or site savings follow.

typical_benefit.wording: "the energy needed to push fluid through bypass lines is wasted." No % stated.
source_titles: S13: Improving Pumping System Performance: A Sourcebook for Industry, 2nd ed. (DOE + Hydraulic Institute; DOE/GO-102006-2079)

questions.limits: Minimum flow protects the pump; never remove it without the pump vendor's minimum continuous flow. Source review: S13 printed8,15,26,51–52 supports vendor minimum-flow protection and system-dependent bypass analysis, not a universal retrofit. The inherited bypass-energy quotation omits this surrounding protective/system context and is not site savings. Candidate values/labels are not accepted operating evidence.
